rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; project retained. Form 4562 line 22 for the business (line 12, lines 14 to 17, line 19 column (g), line 21) on both sides, with line 21 (line 28) summed in another order; within it the second sums asset.f25 over the listed assets where the project sums asset.bonus_2025. asset.f25 is a display line, shown only for listed property placed in service in 2025 (asset.on_26_2025), and copies asset.bonus for every asset; for listed property placed in service before 2025, asset.bonus is the allowance elected in the year of placement (asset.bonus_choice is asked of every asset, for the basis), which is not a 2025 line 25 amount ('If you placed in service certain qualified listed property during the tax year, you may be able to deduct the special depreciation allowance', i4562 p. 13, Line 25). asset.bonus_2025 is that allowance for 2025 property and zero otherwise, so the project is right and the second over-counts an earlier year's allowance. Lines 15, 16 and 20 are refused on the asset (asset.screen), as the second's note says.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; project retained. Two differences. (1) Inside Form 4562 line 28, the second sums asset.f25 over the listed assets where the project sums asset.bonus_2025. asset.f25 is a display line, shown only for listed property placed in service in 2025 (asset.on_26_2025), and copies asset.bonus for every asset; for listed property placed in service before 2025, asset.bonus is the allowance elected in the year of placement (asset.bonus_choice is asked of every asset, for the basis), which is not a 2025 line 25 amount ('If you placed in service certain qualified listed property during the tax year, you may be able to deduct the special depreciation allowance', i4562 p. 13, Line 25). asset.bonus_2025 is that allowance for 2025 property and zero otherwise, so the project is right and the second over-counts an earlier year's allowance. (2) As ruled before: both figure line 31 before the section 179 deduction for Pub. 946's two income limits (pp. 17-19, Steps 1 to 5); the project subtracts the home office deduction of line 30 as figured, the second refigures it inside this line from the worksheet; the line-30 value is the same.
